Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal Awards Compensation in Injury and Death Cases

The Motor Accidents Claims Tribunals (MACT) in Delhi and Mumbai have awarded compensation in separate cases. In Delhi, the MACT awarded Rs 14.58 lakh to a businessman who was injured. In Mumbai, the MACT awarded Rs 33.8 lakh to the family of a man killed in a collision between a truck and a motorcycle.
